programs.title: Deadliest Catch: Of Ice and Men
programs.desc: Sig makes a desperate bid to save his gear from the descending ice pack while Jake dumps pots to avoid capsizing  when Wild Bill gets a line caught in his propeller far from Dutch Harbor, he enlists Jake's diver to attempt a risky underwater repair.

programs.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier: Greener Pastures
programs.desc: With predators stalking the homestead, the need for safe grazing land is greater than ever  Atz Sr. and Atz Lee head to Perl Island to begin plans for a new pasture  Otto and Eivin set to work transporting a small herd to the island by boat.

programs.title: Bering Sea Gold: Ready, Claim, Fire
programs.desc: Tensions run high as Brad leads The Reaper into hostile waters where Emily defends Claim 14 from claim jumpers  Shawn hunts an elusive pay-streak  Ken puts his risky Myrtle Irene repair to the test.
